description: Loại CCHN — dư thừa để filter nhanh (scheme: CERTIFICATE_TYPE)
Trạng thái CCHN — dư thừa để filter nhanh (scheme: CERTIFICATE_STATUS)

etl_logic: LEFT JOIN scr_prac_license_ap ON scr_prac_license_ap.license_ctf_doc_id = scr_prac_license_ctf_doc.scr_prac_license_ctf_doc_id → CASE WHEN scr_prac_license_ap.ap_tp_code IN ('1','2','3') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

etl_logic: LEFT JOIN scr_prac_license_dcsn_doc revok_dcsn ON revok_dcsn.scr_prac_license_dcsn_doc_id = scr_prac_license_ctf_doc.revocation_license_dcsn_id LEFT JOIN scr_prac_license_dcsn_doc cncl_dcsn ON cncl_dcsn.scr_prac_license_dcsn_doc_id = scr_prac_license_ctf_doc.cncl_license_dcsn_id → COALESCE(revok_dcsn.dcsn_tp_code, cncl_dcsn.dcsn_tp_code)
